title.en: An Act Converting the Land Transportation Office (LTO) Licensing Center in the Municipality of Kawit, Province of Cavite Into a Regular Licensing Center to Be Known as the LTO Cavite
title.orig: An Act Converting the Land Transportation Office (LTO) Licensing Center in the Municipality of Kawit, Province of Cavite Into a Regular Licensing Center to Be Known as the LTO Cavite
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Trung tâm Land Transportation Office Licensing tại Đô thị Kawit, Tỉnh Cavite thành Regular Licensing Center với tên gọi LTO Cavite

text.en: The Land Transportation Office (LTO) Licensing Center in the Municipality of Kawit, Cavite is hereby converted into a Regular Licensing Center to be known as the LTO Cavite Licensing Center.

The Secretary of Transportation shall immediately include in the Department’s programs the operationalization of the LTO Cavite Licensing Center, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year’s appropriations of the LTO Cavite Licensing Center. Thereafter, such sums as may be necessary for the continued implementation of this Act shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days following the completion of its publication in the Official Gazette or in two (2) national newspapers of general circulation.
